## 2. Master index structure (user-locked)

Top level **GS-wise** (GS-1 → GS-2 → GS-3 → GS-4), then **subject-wise** inside each paper, then `section_group` → `subtopic` → card links. Anchors: `#ix-gs1…#ix-gs4` + `#ix-master`. Each card link's text is the card's verbatim title (title attribute repeats it); href is `#card-<ID>`.

Counts (script-verified): 551 card links · 209 subtopic rows · 48 section rows · 14 subject rows · 4 paper pages + 1 lead page.

## 3. Anchor namespace (global, unique — verified 0 duplicates, 0 unresolved)

| Pattern | Count | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `#fm-cover · #fm-foreword · #fm-howto · #fm-glance` | 4 | front matter |
| `#pt-gs1 … #pt-gs4` | 4 | part openers |
| `#ch-1 … #ch-14` | 14 | chapters |
| `#sg-1 … #sg-48` | 48 | section groups |
| `#st-1 … #st-209` | 209 | subtopics |
| `#card-<CARD_ID>` | 551 | cards (ID = v17 id, e.g. `#card-GS1-HIST-0001`) |
| `#ix-master · #ix-gs1…#ix-gs4 · #gs4-mini-index` | 6 | index pages |

## 4. Page numbering (stamped at assembly — Phase 7)

Every sheet carries two `.pg-n` placeholders (topbar stamp + foot). `build.py` numbers sheets sequentially in document order and stamps both placeholders per sheet, e.g. `037 / 239`. The cover counts as page 1.
